Chromosome Number
Chromosomes categorized as autosomal or sex chromosomes 
Sex chromosomes determine sex of organism; carry some other characteristics 
In humans, known as X and Y chromosomes 
Males: XY; females: XX 
All other chromosomes known as autosomal 
Humans have total 46 chromosomes
2 sex chromosomes
44 autosomal chromosomes
explanation: Chromosomes are categorized into two groups: sex chromosomes and autosomes (autosomal chromosomes). Sex chromosomes determine the biological sex of the organism and carry some other genetic traits. In humans, the sex chromosomes are X and Y, where males are XY and females are XX. All other chromosomes are autosomes. Humans have a total of 46 chromosomes in each somatic cell, consisting of 2 sex chromosomes and 44 autosomes.

questions.q: How many autosomal chromosomes and sex chromosomes do humans have in a typical diploid cell?
questions.exp: Humans have a total of 46 chromosomes, consisting of 2 sex chromosomes and 44 autosomes.

questions.q: Which of the following chromosome combinations determines biological sex in humans according to the slide?
opts: XY for females, XX for males
XX for females, XY for males
YY for males, XX for females
XO for females, XXY for males
questions.exp: In humans, sex chromosomes determine sex: males are XY and females are XX.
